concerns.text: Constitution VII mandates the ≥10% MAPE improvement be demonstrated 'via paired t-tests on absolute errors', but T006 mandates Wilcoxon signed-rank with an explicit 'NO paired t-test' instruction. A task that directly contradicts a constitutional principle is a constraint violation regardless of the spec's FR-008 wording; either the constitution must be amended or T006 must reconcile the conflict explicitly.

FR-003/FR-004 define Feature Set B as 'process + measured OR estimated stress' (proxy MAY augment Set B), but T004 restricts Set B to the measured-only balanced subset (is_proxy=False). This is a silent narrowing of the spec's Set B definition; the spec has not been revised to authorize it. Make the narrowing explicit in the spec or add a proxy-augmented Set B variant.

US-2 acceptance scenario 2 requires NN training to complete within 60 minutes on the Actions runner. No task measures or verifies this per-model 60-minute constraint (T011 only checks the 6-hour total from SC-005). A dropped acceptance criterion.

T002's verification requires schema validation 'with jsonschema', but the pinned dependency list (plan Technical Context, T001 package check) omits jsonschema. The isolated-venv run would fail at T002. Add it to the pinned dependency set.

T008 introduces a 50–63 'under_power_band' with widened caveats that FR-013 and the spec's edge cases never define (spec only specifies the ≥50 gate). Document this band in the spec, not just in tasks, to avoid retroactive requirement invention.

FR-005's '[deferred]' train/test split proportion is concretized to 80/20 only in T005; the spec placeholder remains unresolved, leaving the authoritative ratio defined solely in the task list. Resolve the placeholder in the spec.
